content.text: Implement targeted fixes in existing expo-audio architecture while preserving simultaneous narration + soundscape playback. Scope: (1) Add transition version/token guard in page-change async flow to prevent stale operations causing bleed on rapid navigation. (2) Strengthen navigation/unmount cleanup to stop/unload screen-scoped audio promptly (not pause-only), without breaking intentional concurrent playback. (3) Wire isTransitioning/loading state end-to-end into AudioControls from reader screen. (4) Tune ducking logic to reduce lag/pumping with deterministic fade transitions. (5) Remove expo-av dependency if truly unused. Keep changes minimal and focused; include brief summary of files changed and rationale.
